q: उस त्रिभुज का लंबकेन्द्र (orthocentre) ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके शीर्ष A(2, -1), B(1, 3) तथा C(-2, 1) हैं।
e:
Step 1: Slope of BC = (1 - 3) / (-2 - 1) = (-2)/(-3) = 2/3.
Altitude through A(2, -1) is ⊥ to BC, so its slope = -3/2.
Equation of altitude AD: y + 1 = (-3/2)(x - 2) ⇒ 2y + 2 = -3x + 6 ⇒ 3x + 2y = 4 ... (1)
Step 2: Slope of AC = (1 - (-1)) / (-2 - 2) = 2/(-4) = -1/2.
Altitude through B(1, 3) is ⊥ to AC, so its slope = 2.
Equation of altitude BE: y - 3 = 2(x - 1) ⇒ 2x - y = -1 ... (2)
Step 3: Solving (1) and (2): From (2), y = 2x + 1. Substituting in (1): 3x + 2(2x + 1) = 4 ⇒ 7x = 2 ⇒ x = 2/7, and y = 2(2/7) + 1 = 11/7.
अतः लंबकेन्द्र (2/7, 11/7) है। (Hence, the orthocentre is (2/7, 11/7).)
qe: Find the orthocentre of the triangle whose vertices are A(2, -1), B(1, 3), and C(-2, 1).

q: सरल रेखा 2x - y + 5 = 0 के सापेक्ष बिंदु (3, -4) का प्रतिबिंब (image) क्या है?
qe: What is the image (reflection) of the point (3, -4) with respect to the straight line 2x - y + 5 = 0?

q: चार सरल रेखाओं 2x + 3y - 1 = 0, 2x + 3y + 7 = 0, 4x - y - 5 = 0 तथा 4x - y + 9 = 0 से बने समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Area of parallelogram formed by a₁x + b₁y + c₁ = 0, a₁x + b₁y + c₂ = 0 and a₂x + b₂y + d₁ = 0, a₂x + b₂y + d₂ = 0 is:
Area = |(c₁ - c₂)(d₁ - d₂) / (a₁b₂ - a₂b₁)|.
Here a₁ = 2, b₁ = 3, c₁ = -1, c₂ = 7; a₂ = 4, b₂ = -1, d₁ = -5, d₂ = 9.
Numerator: |(-1 - 7)(-5 - 9)| = |(-8)(-14)| = 112.
Denominator: |2(-1) - 4(3)| = |-2 - 12| = 14.
Area = 112 ÷ 14 = 8 sq. units.
अतः समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल 8 वर्ग इकाई है।
qe: Find the area of the parallelogram formed by the four lines 2x + 3y - 1 = 0, 2x + 3y + 7 = 0, 4x - y - 5 = 0, and 4x - y + 9 = 0.

q: एक चर सरल रेखा स्थिर बिंदु (2, 3) से होकर जाती है और निर्देशांक अक्षों को A तथा B पर काटती है। त्रिभुज OAB (जहाँ O मूलबिंदु है) के परिकेन्द्र (circumcentre) का बिंदुपथ क्या है?
e:
Let the intercepts on the axes be p and q, so A = (p, 0) and B = (0, q).
Equation of line AB: x/p + y/q = 1.
Since it passes through (2, 3): 2/p + 3/q = 1 ... (1)
Since △OAB is right-angled at O, its circumcentre (h, k) is the midpoint of hypotenuse AB:
h = p/2 ⇒ p = 2h, and k = q/2 ⇒ q = 2k.
Substituting in (1): 2/(2h) + 3/(2k) = 1 ⇒ 1/h + 3/(2k) = 1 ⇒ 2k + 3h = 2hk.
Replacing (h, k) by (x, y), the locus is 3x + 2y = 2xy.
अतः परिकेन्द्र का बिंदुपथ 3x + 2y = 2xy है।
qe: A variable straight line passes through the fixed point (2, 3) and meets the coordinate axes at A and B. What is the locus of the circumcentre of triangle OAB (where O is the origin)?

q: भिन्न वास्तविक प्राचलों p तथा q (p ≠ q) के लिए, तीन रेखाओं (1 + p)x - py + p(1 + p) = 0, (1 + q)x - qy + q(1 + q) = 0 तथा y = 0 से बने त्रिभुज के लंबकेन्द्र का बिंदुपथ क्या है?
e:
Intersection of L₁: (1 + p)x - py + p(1 + p) = 0 with y = 0 gives A(-p, 0).
Intersection of L₂: (1 + q)x - qy + q(1 + q) = 0 with y = 0 gives B(-q, 0).
Solving L₁ and L₂ for vertex C:
Subtracting q·L₁ from p·L₂ eliminates y: (p - q)x = pq(p - q) ⇒ x = pq (since p ≠ q).
Thus the altitude from C perpendicular to y = 0 is the vertical line x = pq.
The altitude from A(-p, 0) is ⊥ to L₂ (whose slope is (1 + q)/q), so its slope is -q/(1 + q).
Equation of altitude through A: y - 0 = [-q/(1 + q)](x + p).
At x = pq: y = [-q/(1 + q)](pq + p) = [-q/(1 + q)]·p(q + 1) = -pq.
Hence the orthocentre is (pq, -pq), which always satisfies x + y = 0.
अतः लंबकेन्द्र का बिंदुपथ सरल रेखा x + y = 0 है।
qe: For distinct real parameters p and q (p ≠ q), what is the locus of the orthocentre of the triangle formed by the three lines (1 + p)x - py + p(1 + p) = 0, (1 + q)x - qy + q(1 + q) = 0, and y = 0?

q: यदि समीकरण ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 द्वारा निरूपित रेखाओं में से एक की प्रवणता दूसरी की प्रवणता की तीन गुनी है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संबंध सत्य है?
e:
Let the slopes of the two lines be m₁ and m₂, with m₂ = 3m₁.
For ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0:
Sum of slopes: m₁ + m₂ = -2h/b ⇒ 4m₁ = -2h/b ⇒ m₁ = -h/(2b).
Product of slopes: m₁m₂ = a/b ⇒ 3m₁² = a/b.
Substituting m₁ = -h/(2b): 3(-h/(2b))² = a/b ⇒ 3h²/(4b²) = a/b ⇒ 3h² = 4ab.
अतः अभीष्ट प्रतिबन्ध 3h² = 4ab है।
qe: If the slope of one of the lines represented by ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 is three times the slope of the other, then which of the following relations holds?

q: λ के किस मान के लिए समीकरण 2x² + 7xy + 3y² + 8x + 14y + λ = 0 एक सरल रेखा युग्म को निरूपित करता है?
e:
Comparing with ax² + 2hxy + by² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0:
a = 2, h = 7/2, b = 3, g = 4, f = 7, c = λ.
Condition for pair of straight lines is Δ = abc + 2fgh - af² - bg² - ch² = 0.
⇒ 2(3)(λ) + 2(7)(4)(7/2) - 2(7²) - 3(4²) - λ(7/2)² = 0
⇒ 6λ + 196 - 98 - 48 - (49/4)λ = 0
⇒ 50 - (25/4)λ = 0 ⇒ (25/4)λ = 50 ⇒ λ = 8.
अतः λ = 8 के लिए दिया गया समीकरण सरल रेखा युग्म निरूपित करता है।
qe: For what value of λ does the equation 2x² + 7xy + 3y² + 8x + 14y + λ = 0 represent a pair of straight lines?

q: समीकरण 2x² - 5xy + 2y² - 3x + 3y + 1 = 0 द्वारा निरूपित सरल रेखा युग्म का प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Let F(x, y) = 2x² - 5xy + 2y² - 3x + 3y + 1 = 0.
The point of intersection satisfies ∂F/∂x = 0 and ∂F/∂y = 0:
∂F/∂x = 4x - 5y - 3 = 0 ... (1)
∂F/∂y = -5x + 4y + 3 = 0 ... (2)
Adding (1) and (2): -x - y = 0 ⇒ y = -x.
Substituting y = -x in (1): 4x - 5(-x) - 3 = 0 ⇒ 9x = 3 ⇒ x = 1/3, and y = -1/3.
अतः प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु (1/3, -1/3) है।
qe: Find the point of intersection of the pair of straight lines represented by 2x² - 5xy + 2y² - 3x + 3y + 1 = 0.

q: यदि सरल रेखा युग्म x² - 2pxy - y² = 0 तथा x² - 2qxy - y² = 0 इस प्रकार हैं कि प्रत्येक युग्म दूसरे युग्म के बीच के कोणों को समद्विभाजित करता है, तो कौन-सा संबंध सही है?
e:
The combined equation of angle bisectors of ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 is (x² - y²)/(a - b) = xy/h.
For x² - 2pxy - y² = 0, a = 1, h = -p, b = -1.
Its angle bisectors are: (x² - y²)/(1 - (-1)) = xy/(-p) ⇒ (x² - y²)/2 = -xy/p ⇒ px² + 2xy - py² = 0 ⇒ x² + (2/p)xy - y² = 0.
Comparing this with the second pair x² - 2qxy - y² = 0:
-2q = 2/p ⇒ pq = -1.
अतः सही संबंध pq = -1 है।
qe: If the pair of straight lines x² - 2pxy - y² = 0 and x² - 2qxy - y² = 0 are such that each pair bisects the angles between the other pair, then which relation is correct?

q: सरल रेखा युग्म 3x² - 10xy + 3y² = 0 तथा सरल रेखा x + y - 4 = 0 द्वारा निर्मित त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
The area of the triangle formed by ax² + 2hxy + by² = 0 and lx + my + n = 0 is:
Area = [n² √(h² - ab)] / |am² - 2hlm + bl²|.
Here a = 3, h = -5, b = 3, l = 1, m = 1, n = -4.
Numerator: (-4)² √((-5)² - 3×3) = 16 × √(25 - 9) = 16 × 4 = 64.
Denominator: |3(1)² - 2(-5)(1)(1) + 3(1)²| = |3 + 10 + 3| = 16.
Area = 64 ÷ 16 = 4 sq. units.
अतः त्रिभुज का क्षेत्रफल 4 वर्ग इकाई है।
qe: Find the area of the triangle formed by the pair of straight lines 3x² - 10xy + 3y² = 0 and the line x + y - 4 = 0.

q: समीकरण 4x² + 12xy + 9y² + 10x + 15y - 6 = 0 समांतर सरल रेखाओं के एक युग्म को निरूपित करता है। उनके बीच की लंबवत दूरी क्या है?
e:
Method 1 (Factorisation):
4x² + 12xy + 9y² + 10x + 15y - 6 = (2x + 3y)² + 5(2x + 3y) - 6 = (2x + 3y + 6)(2x + 3y - 1) = 0.
So the two parallel lines are 2x + 3y + 6 = 0 and 2x + 3y - 1 = 0.
Distance d = |6 - (-1)| / √(2² + 3²) = 7/√13.
Method 2 (Formula): d = 2√[(g² - ac) / (a(a + b))] = 2√[(25 - 4(-6)) / (4×13)] = 2√(49/52) = 7/√13.
अतः समांतर रेखाओं के बीच की दूरी 7/√13 है।
qe: The equation 4x² + 12xy + 9y² + 10x + 15y - 6 = 0 represents a pair of parallel straight lines. What is the perpendicular distance between them?

q: व्यापक द्विघात समीकरण 16x² - 24xy + 9y² - 104x - 172y + 44 = 0 किस शांकव (conic section) को निरूपित करता है?
e:
Comparing with ax² + 2hxy + by² + 2gx + 2fy + c = 0:
a = 16, h = -12, b = 9, g = -52, f = -86, c = 44.
Step 1: Check h² - ab = (-12)² - 16(9) = 144 - 144 = 0.
Step 2: Check whether Δ = 0 (pair of parallel lines) or Δ ≠ 0 (parabola).
Note that 16x² - 24xy + 9y² = (4x - 3y)². If it were parallel lines, -104x - 172y would be a multiple of (4x - 3y).
Check ratio: (-104)/4 = -26, whereas (-172)/(-3) = 172/3 ≠ -26.
Explicitly, Δ = abc + 2fgh - af² - bg² - ch² = -250000 ≠ 0.
Since Δ ≠ 0 and h² = ab, the equation represents a Parabola (परवलय)।
qe: What conic section is represented by the general second-degree equation 16x² - 24xy + 9y² - 104x - 172y + 44 = 0?

q: समीकरण 2x² + 3y² - 8x + 12y + 14 = 0 से प्रथम घात के पदों को हटाने के लिए मूलबिंदु को (h, k) पर स्थानांतरित किया जाता है। नया मूलबिंदु (h, k) और रूपांतरित समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Put x = X + h, y = Y + k, or use partial derivatives for the centre:
∂F/∂x = 4x - 8 = 0 ⇒ h = 2.
∂F/∂y = 6y + 12 = 0 ⇒ k = -2.
New constant term c' = F(2, -2) = 2(2)² + 3(-2)² - 8(2) + 12(-2) + 14 = 8 + 12 - 16 - 24 + 14 = -6.
Hence the transformed equation is 2X² + 3Y² - 6 = 0, i.e., 2X² + 3Y² = 6.
अतः नया मूलबिंदु (2, -2) और नया समीकरण 2X² + 3Y² = 6 है।
qe: To remove the first-degree terms from the equation 2x² + 3y² - 8x + 12y + 14 = 0, the origin must be shifted to (h, k). Find the new origin (h, k) and the transformed equation.

q: निर्देशांक अक्षों को किस न्यून कोण θ से (वामावर्त) घुमाया जाए जिससे समीकरण 7x² + 2√3 xy + 5y² = 16 से xy का पद विलुप्त हो जाए?
e:
To remove the xy-term from ax² + 2hxy + by² = c by rotating axes through angle θ:
tan 2θ = 2h / (a - b).
Here a = 7, 2h = 2√3, b = 5.
tan 2θ = 2√3 / (7 - 5) = 2√3 / 2 = √3.
⇒ 2θ = 60° (π/3) ⇒ θ = 30° (π/6).
अतः अक्षों को 30° (π/6) के कोण से घुमाना चाहिए।
qe: Through what acute angle θ should the coordinate axes be rotated (counter-clockwise) so that the xy-term is eliminated from the equation 7x² + 2√3 xy + 5y² = 16?

q: यदि अक्षों को उपयुक्त कोण से घुमाने पर व्यंजक 5x² + 4xy + 2y² रूपांतरित होकर a'X² + b'Y² (जहाँ a' > b') हो जाता है, तो a' और b' के मान क्या हैं?
e:
Under orthogonal rotation of axes, the two invariants are:
(1) a' + b' = a + b = 5 + 2 = 7.
(2) a'b' - h'² = ab - h². Since h' = 0 and a = 5, h = 2, b = 2:
a'b' = (5)(2) - 2² = 10 - 4 = 6.
Therefore, a' and b' are the roots of t² - 7t + 6 = 0 ⇒ (t - 6)(t - 1) = 0 ⇒ t = 6, 1.
Since a' > b', we get a' = 6, b' = 1.
अतः निश्चर (invariants) के प्रयोग से a' = 6 तथा b' = 1 प्राप्त होता है।
qe: If the expression 5x² + 4xy + 2y² transforms to a'X² + b'Y² (with a' > b') by a rotation of axes through an appropriate angle, then what are the values of a' and b'?

q: घूर्णन निश्चरों (rotational invariants) का उपयोग करके शांकव 5x² - 6xy + 5y² = 8 की उत्केन्द्रता (eccentricity) ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Here a = 5, h = -3, b = 5.
Let the rotated form without the xy-term be a'X² + b'Y² = 8.
By invariants: a' + b' = 5 + 5 = 10, and a'b' = ab - h² = 25 - 9 = 16.
Roots of t² - 10t + 16 = 0 are (t - 8)(t - 2) = 0 ⇒ a' = 8, b' = 2.
Reduced equation: 8X² + 2Y² = 8 ⇒ X²/1 + Y²/4 = 1.
This is an ellipse with semi-major axis A = √4 = 2 and semi-minor axis B = √1 = 1.
Eccentricity e = √(1 - B²/A²) = √(1 - 1/4) = √3/2.
अतः शांकव की उत्केन्द्रता √3/2 है।
qe: Using rotational invariants, find the eccentricity of the conic 5x² - 6xy + 5y² = 8.

q: दीर्घवृत्त 14x² - 4xy + 11y² - 44x - 58y + 71 = 0 के अर्ध-दीर्घ अक्ष (semi-major axis) की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Step 1: Find centre (x₀, y₀) by setting partial derivatives to zero:
∂F/∂x = 28x - 4y - 44 = 0 ⇒ 7x - y = 11 ... (1)
∂F/∂y = -4x + 22y - 58 = 0 ⇒ -2x + 11y = 29 ... (2)
From (1), y = 7x - 11. Substituting in (2): -2x + 11(7x - 11) = 29 ⇒ 75x = 150 ⇒ x₀ = 2, y₀ = 3.
Step 2: New constant term c' = F(2, 3) = 14(4) - 4(6) + 11(9) - 44(2) - 58(3) + 71 = 56 - 24 + 99 - 88 - 174 + 71 = -60.
So shifted equation is 14X² - 4XY + 11Y² = 60.
Step 3: Using invariants for rotation to a'u² + b'v² = 60:
a' + b' = 14 + 11 = 25; a'b' = (14)(11) - (-2)² = 154 - 4 = 150.
Roots of t² - 25t + 150 = 0 are (t - 15)(t - 10) = 0 ⇒ 15 and 10.
Thus 15u² + 10v² = 60 ⇒ u²/4 + v²/6 = 1.
Hence semi-major axis = √6.
अतः अर्ध-दीर्घ अक्ष की लंबाई √6 है।
qe: Find the length of the semi-major axis of the ellipse given by 14x² - 4xy + 11y² - 44x - 58y + 71 = 0.

q: यदि दो वृत्त 2x² + 2y² - 6x + 4y + k = 0 तथा x² + y² + 2x - 8y - 6 = 0 परस्पर लंबकोणीय (orthogonally) प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं, तो k का मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
First convert the first circle to standard form (coefficient of x² and y² equal to 1):
x² + y² - 3x + 2y + k/2 = 0 ⇒ g₁ = -3/2, f₁ = 1, c₁ = k/2.
For the second circle x² + y² + 2x - 8y - 6 = 0: g₂ = 1, f₂ = -4, c₂ = -6.
Condition for orthogonal intersection: 2g₁g₂ + 2f₁f₂ = c₁ + c₂.
⇒ 2(-3/2)(1) + 2(1)(-4) = k/2 + (-6)
⇒ -3 - 8 = k/2 - 6 ⇒ -11 + 6 = k/2 ⇒ -5 = k/2 ⇒ k = -10.
अतः k = -10 है।
qe: If the two circles 2x² + 2y² - 6x + 4y + k = 0 and x² + y² + 2x - 8y - 6 = 0 intersect orthogonally, find the value of k.

q: तीन वृत्तों x² + y² - 2x - 2y + 1 = 0, x² + y² - 4x + 2y - 3 = 0 तथा x² + y² + 2x - 4y - 5 = 0 का मूलाक्ष केन्द्र (radical centre) ज्ञात कीजिए।
qe: Find the radical centre of the three circles x² + y² - 2x - 2y + 1 = 0, x² + y² - 4x + 2y - 3 = 0, and x² + y² + 2x - 4y - 5 = 0.

q: बिंदु P(6, 3) से वृत्त x² + y² - 4x - 6y + 9 = 0 पर खींची गई स्पर्श रेखाओं के युग्म के बीच का कोण कितना है?
e:
For circle x² + y² - 4x - 6y + 9 = 0:
Centre C = (2, 3), radius r = √(2² + 3² - 9) = √4 = 2.
Distance from P(6, 3) to C(2, 3): d = √[(6 - 2)² + (3 - 3)²] = 4.
If θ is the angle between the two tangents, then sin(θ/2) = r / d = 2 / 4 = 1/2.
⇒ θ/2 = 30° ⇒ θ = 60° (π/3).
अतः दोनों स्पर्श रेखाओं के बीच का कोण 60° (π/3) है।
qe: What is the angle between the pair of tangents drawn from the point P(6, 3) to the circle x² + y² - 4x - 6y + 9 = 0?

q: वृत्त x² + y² - 6x - 8y + 5 = 0 के सापेक्ष सरल रेखा 3x + 4y - 45 = 0 का ध्रुव (pole) ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Let the pole be (x₁, y₁). Its polar with respect to x² + y² - 6x - 8y + 5 = 0 is T = 0:
xx₁ + yy₁ - 3(x + x₁) - 4(y + y₁) + 5 = 0
⇒ (x₁ - 3)x + (y₁ - 4)y + (-3x₁ - 4y₁ + 5) = 0.
Comparing coefficients with 3x + 4y - 45 = 0:
(x₁ - 3)/3 = (y₁ - 4)/4 = (-3x₁ - 4y₁ + 5)/(-45) = k (say).
⇒ x₁ = 3k + 3, y₁ = 4k + 4.
Substitute in the third ratio: -3(3k + 3) - 4(4k + 4) + 5 = -45k
⇒ -25k - 20 = -45k ⇒ 20k = 20 ⇒ k = 1.
Thus x₁ = 6, y₁ = 8.
अतः अभीष्ट ध्रुव (6, 8) है।
qe: Find the pole of the straight line 3x + 4y - 45 = 0 with respect to the circle x² + y² - 6x - 8y + 5 = 0.

q: वृत्त x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 3 = 0 की उन दो स्पर्श रेखाओं के प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु का बिंदुपथ क्या है जो एक-दूसरे से 60° के कोण पर झुकी हुई हैं?
e:
For circle x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 3 = 0:
Centre C = (2, -3), radius r = √(2² + (-3)² - (-3)) = √16 = 4.
Let P(h, k) be the point of intersection of two tangents inclined at θ = 60°.
Then sin(θ/2) = r / CP ⇒ sin 30° = 4 / CP ⇒ 1/2 = 4 / CP ⇒ CP = 8.
Squaring both sides: (h - 2)² + (k + 3)² = 8² = 64
⇒ h² - 4h + 4 + k² + 6k + 9 - 64 = 0 ⇒ h² + k² - 4h + 6k - 51 = 0.
Replacing (h, k) by (x, y), the locus is x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 51 = 0.
अतः अभीष्ट बिंदुपथ x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 51 = 0 है।
qe: What is the equation of the locus of the point of intersection of two tangents to the circle x² + y² - 4x + 6y - 3 = 0 that are inclined to each other at an angle of 60°?

q: दो वृत्तों x² + y² - 2y - 5 = 0 तथा x² + y² - 10x - 12y + 45 = 0 द्वारा निर्धारित समाक्ष वृत्त निकाय (coaxial system of circles) के सीमांत बिंदु (limiting points) ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Radical axis L = S₁ - S₂ = 0:
10x + 10y - 50 = 0 ⇒ x + y - 5 = 0.
Any circle of the coaxial system is S₁ + 2kL = 0:
x² + y² + 2kx + (2k - 2)y + (-5 - 10k) = 0.
Its centre is (-k, 1 - k), and its radius squared is:
r² = k² + (k - 1)² - (-5 - 10k) = 2k² + 8k + 6.
For limiting points (point circles), set r² = 0:
2k² + 8k + 6 = 0 ⇒ k² + 4k + 3 = 0 ⇒ (k + 1)(k + 3) = 0 ⇒ k = -1 or k = -3.
For k = -1: centre = (1, 2). For k = -3: centre = (3, 4).
अतः सीमांत बिंदु (1, 2) तथा (3, 4) हैं।
qe: Find the limiting points of the coaxial system of circles determined by the two circles x² + y² - 2y - 5 = 0 and x² + y² - 10x - 12y + 45 = 0.

q: उस वृत्त का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जो तीनों वृत्तों x² + y² + 2x - 3 = 0, x² + y² + 2y - 5 = 0 तथा x² + y² - 4x + 2y - 1 = 0 को लंबकोणीय (orthogonally) काटता है।
e:
The centre of the orthogonal circle is the radical centre of S₁, S₂, S₃, and its radius is the length of tangent from the radical centre to any of the circles.
S₁ - S₂ = 0 ⇒ 2x - 2y + 2 = 0 ⇒ y = x + 1 ... (1)
S₂ - S₃ = 0 ⇒ 4x - 4 = 0 ⇒ x = 1.
From (1), y = 2. So radical centre = (1, 2).
Radius² = S₁(1, 2) = 1² + 2² + 2(1) - 3 = 1 + 4 + 2 - 3 = 4.
Required circle: (x - 1)² + (y - 2)² = 4 ⇒ x² + y² - 2x - 4y + 1 = 0.
अतः अभीष्ट लंबकोणीय वृत्त x² + y² - 2x - 4y + 1 = 0 है।
qe: Find the equation of the circle that cuts each of the three circles x² + y² + 2x - 3 = 0, x² + y² + 2y - 5 = 0, and x² + y² - 4x + 2y - 1 = 0 orthogonally.

q: परवलय y² = 12x की एक नाभीय जीवा (focal chord) का एक सिरा (12, 12) है। इस नाभीय जीवा की कुल लंबाई कितनी है?
e:
Comparing y² = 12x with y² = 4ax gives a = 3.
Parametric point is (at², 2at) = (3t², 6t).
For (12, 12): 6t₁ = 12 ⇒ t₁ = 2 (and 3(2)² = 12, verified).
Length of focal chord with parameter t₁ is a(t₁ + 1/t₁)².
Length = 3 × (2 + 1/2)² = 3 × (5/2)² = 3 × 25/4 = 75/4.
अतः नाभीय जीवा की लंबाई 75/4 इकाई है।
qe: One extremity of a focal chord of the parabola y² = 12x is (12, 12). What is the total length of this focal chord?

q: परवलय y² = 8x तथा वृत्त x² + y² = 2 की उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाओं (common tangents) के समीकरण क्या हैं?
e:
For y² = 8x, a = 2. Any tangent of slope m is y = mx + 2/m, i.e., mx - y + 2/m = 0.
For this line to touch the circle x² + y² = 2 (centre (0, 0), radius √2):
|2/m| / √(m² + 1) = √2 ⇒ 4/m² = 2(m² + 1) ⇒ m⁴ + m² - 2 = 0.
⇒ (m² + 2)(m² - 1) = 0 ⇒ m² = 1 ⇒ m = ±1 (since m is real).
For m = 1: y = x + 2. For m = -1: y = -x - 2 = -(x + 2).
अतः उभयनिष्ठ स्पर्श रेखाएँ y = ±(x + 2) हैं।
qe: What are the equations of the common tangents to the parabola y² = 8x and the circle x² + y² = 2?

q: परवलय y² = 8x के बिंदु P(2, 4) पर खींचा गया अभिलंब (normal) परवलय को पुनः बिंदु Q पर मिलता है। Q के निर्देशांक ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Comparing y² = 8x with y² = 4ax gives a = 2.
At P(2, 4): 2at₁ = 4 ⇒ 4t₁ = 4 ⇒ t₁ = 1.
If the normal at t₁ meets the parabola again at t₂, then t₂ = -t₁ - 2/t₁.
Here t₂ = -1 - 2/1 = -3.
Coordinates of Q = (at₂², 2at₂) = (2(-3)², 4(-3)) = (18, -12).
अतः बिंदु Q के निर्देशांक (18, -12) हैं।
qe: The normal drawn at the point P(2, 4) to the parabola y² = 8x meets the parabola again at the point Q. Find the coordinates of Q.

q: परवलय y² = 4ax के दो परस्पर लंबवत अभिलंबों (mutually perpendicular normals) के प्रतिच्छेदन बिंदु का बिंदुपथ क्या है?
e:
Equation of normal to y² = 4ax in slope form is y = mx - 2am - am³, or am³ + (2a - x)m + y = 0.
Let its three roots (slopes of normals from (x, y)) be m₁, m₂, m₃.
Then m₁ + m₂ + m₃ = 0 ... (1), m₁m₂ + m₂m₃ + m₃m₁ = (2a - x)/a ... (2), and m₁m₂m₃ = -y/a ... (3).
Since two normals are perpendicular, m₁m₂ = -1.
From (3): (-1)m₃ = -y/a ⇒ m₃ = y/a.
From (1): m₁ + m₂ = -m₃.
Substitute in (2): -1 + m₃(m₁ + m₂) = (2a - x)/a ⇒ -1 - m₃² = 2 - x/a
⇒ m₃² = x/a - 3 ⇒ (y/a)² = (x - 3a)/a ⇒ y² = a(x - 3a).
अतः अभीष्ट बिंदुपथ y² = a(x - 3a) है।
qe: What is the locus of the point of intersection of two mutually perpendicular normals to the parabola y² = 4ax?

q: दीर्घवृत्त 9x² + 16y² - 36x + 96y + 36 = 0 की उत्केन्द्रता (e) तथा नाभिलंब जीवा (latus rectum) की लंबाई ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Completing the square:
9(x² - 4x + 4) + 16(y² + 6y + 9) = -36 + 36 + 144 = 144
⇒ 9(x - 2)² + 16(y + 3)² = 144
⇒ (x - 2)²/16 + (y + 3)²/9 = 1.
Here a² = 16 (a = 4) and b² = 9 (b = 3).
Eccentricity e = √(1 - b²/a²) = √(1 - 9/16) = √7/4.
Length of latus rectum = 2b²/a = (2 × 9)/4 = 9/2.
अतः उत्केन्द्रता √7/4 तथा नाभिलंब जीवा की लंबाई 9/2 है।
qe: Find the eccentricity (e) and the length of the latus rectum of the ellipse 9x² + 16y² - 36x + 96y + 36 = 0.

q: k के किन मानों के लिए सरल रेखा 3x + 5y = k दीर्घवृत्त x²/25 + y²/16 = 1 को स्पर्श करती है?
e:
The line lx + my = n touches the ellipse x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 if and only if a²l² + b²m² = n².
Here a² = 25, b² = 16, l = 3, m = 5, n = k.
k² = 25(3)² + 16(5)² = 25(9) + 16(25) = 225 + 400 = 625.
⇒ k = ±25.
अतः k = ±25 के लिए रेखा दीर्घवृत्त की स्पर्श रेखा है।
qe: For what values of k does the straight line 3x + 5y = k touch the ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1?

q: यदि उत्केन्द्रता e वाले किसी दीर्घवृत्त के नाभिलंब (latus rectum) के एक सिरे पर खींचा गया अभिलंब उसके लघु अक्ष (minor axis) के एक सिरे से होकर जाता है, तो e किस समीकरण को संतुष्ट करता है?
e:
One extremity of the latus rectum of x²/a² + y²/b² = 1 is (ae, b²/a).
Equation of normal at (x₁, y₁) is a²x/x₁ - b²y/y₁ = a² - b².
At (ae, b²/a): a²x/(ae) - b²y/(b²/a) = a² - b² ⇒ ax/e - ay = a² - b².
This passes through the extremity (0, -b) of the minor axis:
0 - a(-b) = a² - b² ⇒ ab = a²e² (since a² - b² = a²e²)
⇒ b/a = e².
Squaring both sides: b²/a² = e⁴ ⇒ 1 - e² = e⁴ ⇒ e⁴ + e² - 1 = 0.
अतः उत्केन्द्रता e समीकरण e⁴ + e² - 1 = 0 को संतुष्ट करती है।
qe: If the normal at one extremity of the latus rectum of an ellipse with eccentricity e passes through one extremity of its minor axis, then e satisfies which equation?

q: दीर्घवृत्त x²/36 + y²/9 = 1 की उस जीवा का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका मध्यबिंदु (2, 1) है।
e:
The equation of a chord with middle point (x₁, y₁) is T = S₁.
Here S: x²/36 + y²/9 - 1 = 0, and (x₁, y₁) = (2, 1).
T = 2x/36 + 1·y/9 - 1 = x/18 + y/9 - 1.
S₁ = 2²/36 + 1²/9 - 1 = 4/36 + 1/9 - 1 = 2/9 - 1.
Setting T = S₁: x/18 + y/9 - 1 = 2/9 - 1 ⇒ x/18 + y/9 = 2/9.
Multiplying by 18: x + 2y = 4.
अतः अभीष्ट जीवा का समीकरण x + 2y = 4 है।
qe: Find the equation of the chord of the ellipse x²/36 + y²/9 = 1 whose middle point is (2, 1).

q: यदि e₁ तथा e₂ क्रमशः एक अतिपरवलय और उसके संयुग्मी अतिपरवलय (conjugate hyperbola) की उत्केन्द्रताएँ हैं, और e₁ = 5/3 है, तो e₂ का मान क्या है?
e:
For a hyperbola and its conjugate hyperbola, the eccentricities satisfy:
1/e₁² + 1/e₂² = 1.
Given e₁ = 5/3 ⇒ 1/e₁² = 9/25.
⇒ 1/e₂² = 1 - 9/25 = 16/25 ⇒ e₂ = 5/4 (since e₂ > 0).
अतः संयुग्मी अतिपरवलय की उत्केन्द्रता e₂ = 5/4 है।
qe: If e₁ and e₂ are the eccentricities of a hyperbola and its conjugate hyperbola respectively, and e₁ = 5/3, then what is the value of e₂?

q: एक अतिपरवलय का समीकरण 2x² + 5xy + 2y² + 4x + 5y + 1 = 0 है। इसके संयुग्मी अतिपरवलय (conjugate hyperbola) का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
The asymptotes differ from the hyperbola only by a constant: A: 2x² + 5xy + 2y² + 4x + 5y + k = 0.
Since asymptotes form a pair of straight lines, Δ = 0 with a = 2, h = 5/2, b = 2, g = 2, f = 5/2, c = k:
2(2)(k) + 2(5/2)(2)(5/2) - 2(25/4) - 2(4) - k(25/4) = 0
⇒ 4k + 25 - 25/2 - 8 - (25/4)k = 0
⇒ 9/2 - (9/4)k = 0 ⇒ k = 2.
By the relation H + C = 2A (Hyperbola + Conjugate = 2 × Asymptotes):
Constant of conjugate hyperbola = 2k - 1 = 2(2) - 1 = 3.
Thus conjugate hyperbola is 2x² + 5xy + 2y² + 4x + 5y + 3 = 0.
अतः संयुग्मी अतिपरवलय का समीकरण 2x² + 5xy + 2y² + 4x + 5y + 3 = 0 है।
qe: The equation of a hyperbola is 2x² + 5xy + 2y² + 4x + 5y + 1 = 0. Find the equation of its conjugate hyperbola.

q: यदि समकोणीय अतिपरवलय (rectangular hyperbola) xy = c² के बिंदु (ct₁, c/t₁) पर खींचा गया अभिलंब वक्र को पुनः बिंदु (ct₂, c/t₂) पर मिलता है, तो निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सा संबंध सत्य है?
e:
Differentiating xy = c² gives x(dy/dx) + y = 0 ⇒ dy/dx = -y/x.
At (ct₁, c/t₁), slope of tangent = -(c/t₁)/(ct₁) = -1/t₁².
Therefore, slope of the normal at t₁ is m_N = t₁².
The slope of the chord joining (ct₁, c/t₁) and (ct₂, c/t₂) is:
m = (c/t₂ - c/t₁) / (ct₂ - ct₁) = [(t₁ - t₂)/(t₁t₂)] / (t₂ - t₁) = -1/(t₁t₂).
Equating the two slopes: t₁² = -1/(t₁t₂) ⇒ t₁³t₂ = -1.
अतः सही संबंध t₁³t₂ = -1 है।
qe: If the normal to the rectangular hyperbola xy = c² at the point (ct₁, c/t₁) meets the curve again at (ct₂, c/t₂), then which of the following relations holds?

q: यदि दीर्घवृत्त x²/25 + y²/16 = 1 तथा अतिपरवलय x²/k - y²/5 = 1 संनाभीय (confocal) हैं, तो k का मान तथा दोनों शांकवों के बीच का प्रतिच्छेदन कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
For the ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1: c² = a² - b² = 25 - 16 = 9, so foci are (±3, 0).
For the hyperbola x²/k - y²/5 = 1: c² = A² + B² = k + 5.
Since they are confocal: k + 5 = 9 ⇒ k = 4.
By a fundamental theorem of conics, confocal ellipses and hyperbolas always intersect orthogonally, i.e., at 90° (π/2).
अतः k = 4 तथा प्रतिच्छेदन कोण 90° है।
qe: If the ellipse x²/25 + y²/16 = 1 and the hyperbola x²/k - y²/5 = 1 are confocal (share the same foci), then find the value of k and the angle of intersection between the two conics.

q: ध्रुवीय निर्देशांकों में दिए गए शांकव 12/r = 3 + 5 cos θ की उत्केन्द्रता (e), नाभिलंब (latus rectum) की लंबाई तथा शांकव की प्रकृति ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Dividing both sides of 12/r = 3 + 5 cos θ by 3 to match the standard form l/r = 1 + e cos θ:
4/r = 1 + (5/3) cos θ.
Here semi-latus rectum l = 4, so full latus rectum = 2l = 8.
Eccentricity e = 5/3 > 1, which represents a Hyperbola (अतिपरवलय)।
अतः e = 5/3, नाभिलंब = 8 तथा शांकव अतिपरवलय है।
qe: For the conic given in polar coordinates by 12/r = 3 + 5 cos θ, find the eccentricity (e), the length of the latus rectum, and the nature of the conic.

q: शांकव l/r = 1 + e cos θ की नाभीय जीवा PSQ है, जहाँ S नाभि (ध्रुव) है। यदि SP = 4 तथा SQ = 12 है, तो अर्ध-नाभिलंब (semi-latus rectum) l ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Let the vectorial angle of P be α; then the vectorial angle of Q is α + π.
l/SP = 1 + e cos α, and l/SQ = 1 + e cos(α + π) = 1 - e cos α.
Adding the two equations: l/SP + l/SQ = 2 ⇒ 1/SP + 1/SQ = 2/l.
Substituting SP = 4 and SQ = 12:
1/4 + 1/12 = 2/l ⇒ 4/12 = 2/l ⇒ 1/3 = 2/l ⇒ l = 6.
अतः अर्ध-नाभिलंब l = 6 है।
qe: PSQ is a focal chord of the conic l/r = 1 + e cos θ, where S is the focus (pole). If SP = 4 and SQ = 12, find the semi-latus rectum l.

q: शांकव 6/r = 2 + cos(θ - π/3) की नाभि (ध्रुव) के संगत नियता (directrix) का ध्रुवीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Rewrite the conic in standard form l/r = 1 + e cos(θ - α) by dividing by 2:
3/r = 1 + (1/2) cos(θ - π/3).
Here l = 3, e = 1/2, α = π/3.
The directrix corresponding to the pole is l/r = e cos(θ - α):
3/r = (1/2) cos(θ - π/3) ⇒ 6/r = cos(θ - π/3) ⇒ r cos(θ - π/3) = 6.
अतः नियता का ध्रुवीय समीकरण r cos(θ - π/3) = 6 है।
qe: Find the polar equation of the directrix corresponding to the focus (pole) of the conic 6/r = 2 + cos(θ - π/3).

q: शांकव 8/r = 1 + 2 cos θ के उस बिंदु पर स्पर्श रेखा का ध्रुवीय समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका सदिश कोण θ = π/2 है।
e:
The tangent to the conic l/r = 1 + e cos θ at the point with vectorial angle α is:
l/r = e cos θ + cos(θ - α).
Here l = 8, e = 2, and α = π/2.
Substituting these values:
8/r = 2 cos θ + cos(θ - π/2) = 2 cos θ + sin θ.
अतः स्पर्श रेखा का ध्रुवीय समीकरण 8/r = 2 cos θ + sin θ है।
qe: Find the polar equation of the tangent to the conic 8/r = 1 + 2 cos θ at the point where the vectorial angle is θ = π/2.

q: सरल रेखा l/r = A cos θ + B sin θ के शांकव l/r = 1 + e cos θ को स्पर्श करने का आवश्यक एवं पर्याप्त प्रतिबन्ध क्या है?
e:
Any tangent to the conic l/r = 1 + e cos θ at vectorial angle α is:
l/r = e cos θ + cos(θ - α) = (e + cos α) cos θ + (sin α) sin θ.
Comparing this with the given line l/r = A cos θ + B sin θ:
A = e + cos α ⇒ cos α = A - e, and B = sin α.
Eliminating α using cos²α + sin²α = 1 gives:
(A - e)² + B² = 1.
अतः अभीष्ट स्पर्शता प्रतिबन्ध (A - e)² + B² = 1 है।
qe: What is the necessary and sufficient condition for the straight line l/r = A cos θ + B sin θ to touch the conic l/r = 1 + e cos θ?

e:
A sphere passing through the origin (0, 0, 0) and cutting intercepts a, b, c on the coordinate axes has the equation:
x² + y² + z² - ax - by - cz = 0.
Here a = 2, b = 4, c = 6 ⇒ x² + y² + z² - 2x - 4y - 6z = 0.
Centre = (a/2, b/2, c/2) = (1, 2, 3).
Radius = √(1² + 2² + 3²) = √(1 + 4 + 9) = √14.
अतः गोले का केन्द्र (1, 2, 3) तथा त्रिज्या √14 है।
qe: Find the centre and radius of the sphere passing through the four points (0, 0, 0), (2, 0, 0), (0, 4, 0), and (0, 0, 6).

q: गोले x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z - 11 = 0 तथा समतल 2x - y + 2z = 1 के प्रतिच्छेदन से बने वृत्त की त्रिज्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
For the sphere x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z - 11 = 0:
Centre C = (1, -2, 3), radius R = √(1² + (-2)² + 3² - (-11)) = √25 = 5.
Perpendicular distance p from C(1, -2, 3) to plane 2x - y + 2z - 1 = 0:
p = |2(1) - (-2) + 2(3) - 1| / √(2² + (-1)² + 2²) = |2 + 2 + 6 - 1| / 3 = 9 / 3 = 3.
Radius of the section circle r = √(R² - p²) = √(5² - 3²) = √16 = 4.
अतः प्रतिच्छेद वृत्त की त्रिज्या 4 इकाई है।
qe: Find the radius of the circle of intersection of the sphere x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z - 11 = 0 and the plane 2x - y + 2z = 1.

q: k के किस मान के लिए दो गोले x² + y² + z² + 2x - 4y + 6z + k = 0 तथा x² + y² + z² - 6x + 2y - 4z - 2 = 0 परस्पर लंबकोणीय (orthogonally) प्रतिच्छेद करते हैं?
e:
Condition for orthogonality of two spheres is 2u₁u₂ + 2v₁v₂ + 2w₁w₂ = d₁ + d₂.
Here u₁ = 1, v₁ = -2, w₁ = 3, d₁ = k; u₂ = -3, v₂ = 1, w₂ = -2, d₂ = -2.
2[(1)(-3) + (-2)(1) + (3)(-2)] = k + (-2)
⇒ 2(-3 - 2 - 6) = k - 2 ⇒ -22 = k - 2 ⇒ k = -20.
अतः k = -20 के लिए दोनों गोले लंबकोणीय हैं।
qe: For what value of k do the two spheres x² + y² + z² + 2x - 4y + 6z + k = 0 and x² + y² + z² - 6x + 2y - 4z - 2 = 0 intersect orthogonally?

q: k के वे मान ज्ञात कीजिए जिनके लिए समतल 2x - 2y + z + k = 0 गोले x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z + 5 = 0 का स्पर्श समतल (tangent plane) है।
e:
For sphere x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z + 5 = 0:
Centre C = (1, -2, 3), radius R = √(1² + (-2)² + 3² - 5) = √9 = 3.
For the plane 2x - 2y + z + k = 0 to touch the sphere, perpendicular distance from C equals R:
|2(1) - 2(-2) + 3 + k| / √(2² + (-2)² + 1²) = 3
⇒ |9 + k| / 3 = 3 ⇒ |9 + k| = 9
⇒ 9 + k = 9 or 9 + k = -9 ⇒ k = 0 or k = -18.
अतः k = 0 या -18 है।
qe: Find the values of k for which the plane 2x - 2y + z + k = 0 is a tangent plane to the sphere x² + y² + z² - 2x + 4y - 6z + 5 = 0.

q: उस लंब वृत्तीय शंकु (right circular cone) का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका शीर्ष मूलबिंदु है, अक्ष रेखा x/1 = y/2 = z/2 है तथा अर्ध-शीर्ष कोण 60° है।
e:
Let P(x, y, z) be any point on the cone. The direction ratios of generator OP are (x, y, z) and of the axis are (1, 2, 2).
Since the angle between them is 60° (cos 60° = 1/2):
(1·x + 2·y + 2·z) / [√(1² + 2² + 2²) √(x² + y² + z²)] = 1/2
⇒ (x + 2y + 2z) / [3√(x² + y² + z²)] = 1/2.
Squaring and cross-multiplying:
4(x + 2y + 2z)² = 9(x² + y² + z²)
⇒ 4(x² + 4y² + 4z² + 4xy + 4xz + 8yz) = 9x² + 9y² + 9z²
⇒ 5x² - 7y² - 7z² - 16xy - 16xz - 32yz = 0.
अतः अभीष्ट शंकु का समीकरण 5x² - 7y² - 7z² - 16xy - 16xz - 32yz = 0 है।
qe: Find the equation of the right circular cone with vertex at the origin, axis along the line x/1 = y/2 = z/2, and semi-vertical angle 60°.

q: शंकु ax² + by² + cz² = 0 (a, b, c ≠ 0) के तीन परस्पर लंबवत स्पर्श समतल (mutually perpendicular tangent planes) होने का आवश्यक एवं पर्याप्त प्रतिबन्ध क्या है?
e:
A cone S has three mutually perpendicular tangent planes if and only if its reciprocal cone S' has three mutually perpendicular generators.
The reciprocal cone of ax² + by² + cz² = 0 is x²/a + y²/b + z²/c = 0.
A homogeneous cone Ax² + By² + Cz² + 2Fyz + 2Gzx + 2Hxy = 0 has three mutually perpendicular generators iff A + B + C = 0.
Applying this to the reciprocal cone: 1/a + 1/b + 1/c = 0 ⇒ (ab + bc + ca)/(abc) = 0 ⇒ ab + bc + ca = 0.
अतः आवश्यक प्रतिबन्ध ab + bc + ca = 0 है।
qe: What is the necessary and sufficient condition that the cone ax² + by² + cz² = 0 (a, b, c ≠ 0) has three mutually perpendicular tangent planes?

q: शंकु x² + 2y² + 3z² - 2yz = 0 के व्युत्क्रम शंकु (reciprocal cone) का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
e:
Comparing with ax² + by² + cz² + 2fyz + 2gzx + 2hxy = 0:
a = 1, b = 2, c = 3, f = -1, g = 0, h = 0.
The reciprocal cone is Ax² + By² + Cz² + 2Fyz + 2Gzx + 2Hxy = 0, where A, B, C, F, G, H are cofactors in the symmetric matrix:
A = bc - f² = 2(3) - (-1)² = 5,
B = ca - g² = 3(1) - 0 = 3,
C = ab - h² = 1(2) - 0 = 2,
F = gh - af = 0 - 1(-1) = 1,
G = hf - bg = 0, H = fg - ch = 0.
Hence the reciprocal cone is 5x² + 3y² + 2z² + 2yz = 0.
अतः व्युत्क्रम शंकु का समीकरण 5x² + 3y² + 2z² + 2yz = 0 है।
qe: Find the equation of the reciprocal cone of the cone x² + 2y² + 3z² - 2yz = 0.

q: गोले x² + y² + z² = 9 के उस अन्वालोपी शंकु (enveloping cone) का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका शीर्ष बिंदु (2, 2, 2) पर है।
e:
The enveloping cone from (x₁, y₁, z₁) to S = 0 is given by SS₁ = T².
Here S = x² + y² + z² - 9, and vertex is (2, 2, 2).
S₁ = 2² + 2² + 2² - 9 = 12 - 9 = 3.
T = 2x + 2y + 2z - 9.
Thus T² - SS₁ = 0:
(2x + 2y + 2z - 9)² - 3(x² + y² + z² - 9) = 0
⇒ (4x² + 4y² + 4z² + 8xy + 8yz + 8zx - 36x - 36y - 36z + 81) - (3x² + 3y² + 3z² - 27) = 0
⇒ x² + y² + z² + 8xy + 8yz + 8zx - 36x - 36y - 36z + 108 = 0.
अतः अन्वालोपी शंकु का समीकरण x² + y² + z² + 8xy + 8yz + 8zx - 36x - 36y - 36z + 108 = 0 है।
qe: Find the equation of the enveloping cone of the sphere x² + y² + z² = 9 with its vertex at the point (2, 2, 2).

q: त्रिज्या 2 वाले उस लंब वृत्तीय बेलन (right circular cylinder) का समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए जिसका अक्ष सरल रेखा x/1 = y/2 = z/2 है।
e:
The axis passes through O(0, 0, 0) with direction ratios (1, 2, 2).
Direction cosines of the axis are l = 1/3, m = 2/3, n = 2/3 (since √(1² + 2² + 2²) = 3).
For any point P(x, y, z) on the cylinder of radius r = 2, the perpendicular distance from P to the axis equals r:
OP² - (projection of OP on axis)² = r²
⇒ (x² + y² + z²) - [(x + 2y + 2z)/3]² = 2² = 4.
Multiplying by 9:
9(x² + y² + z²) - (x² + 4y² + 4z² + 4xy + 4xz + 8yz) = 36
⇒ 8x² + 5y² + 5z² - 4xy - 4xz - 8yz = 36.
अतः लंब वृत्तीय बेलन का समीकरण 8x² + 5y² + 5z² - 4xy - 4xz - 8yz = 36 है।
qe: Find the equation of the right circular cylinder of radius 2 whose axis is the straight line x/1 = y/2 = z/2.
